_doc: Stage 1 of the Florida-to-Bahamas map (docs/world-bimini): Biscayne Bay and the Miami coast out past Fowey Rocks, NOAA ENC chart, USGS 3DEP land, CO-OPS tides; the frame member of MiamiBimini. Fetch with Tools/coast/fetch_miami_bimini.py, bake with build_coast.py MiamiBiscayne. Positions are lat/lon (NAD83). Positions here are from public charts and gazetteers, to be checked against the ENC after the first bake (the bake's checkpoints report the distance to the charted shore).
name: MiamiBiscayne
center_note: Dinner Key, Coconut Grove: the bay's sailing clubs and schools

elevation.note: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second (NAVD88; the FL_MiamiDade_D23 1 m lidar is the shore-detail upgrade)

datum.name: MLLW (chart datum); heights in meters above it

tides.note: Virginia Key (8723214) is the bay's reference station; fetch_miami_bimini.py lists every harmonic station in the box in Data/MiamiBiscayne/raw/tides/stations_in_box.json to add here

launch: Off Fowey Rocks, bound for Bimini
